juke.definition:
n. a small roadside establishment in the southeastern United States where you can eat and drink and dance to music provided by a jukebox
n. (football) a deceptive move made by a football player

juke joint.translation: <美>备有自动唱机的小酒吧（或小餐馆、小舞场）

juke-box.translation: n. 自动点唱机（小餐馆、酒吧等的投币选唱机）

juke-boxes.translation: (juke-box 的复数) n. 自动点唱机（小餐馆、酒吧等的投币选唱机）

jukebox.definition: n. a cabinet containing an automatic record player; records are played by inserting a coin

jukeboxes.definition: n. a cabinet containing an automatic record player; records are played by inserting a coin
jukeboxes.translation: n. 自动唱片点唱机( jukebox的复数形式 )

jukes.definition:
n a small roadside establishment in the southeastern United States where you can eat and drink and dance to music provided by a jukebox

jukes.translation: n. 一个假想的疾病、贫穷与犯罪数代相传的纽约家族

jukes unit.translation: [医] 朱克斯氏单位(每日核黄素饲养鼠的单位数)

jukes-lepowsky unit.translation: [医] 朱-列二氏单位(一种滤液因子的效能单位)

juku.translation: n. (在日本, 附属于正规学校的)为学生参加大学入学考试做准备的学校
